title: Simulation harness for input/output sensitivity and security-questionnaire billing mapping
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: build a repeatable simulation harness that measures revenue and SLA impact across a broad range of per-session I/O ratios, streaming vs batch modes, and minimum-billing/soft-credit policies; produce a mapping that translates common enterprise security-questionnaire answers (eg. data residency, VPC, audit log retention) into contract/billing constraints and operational knobs.

Why this ticket exists: Commercial and legal teams are seeing two recurring requests from enterprise prospects: (1) granular control over input vs output token billing for predictable unit economics, and (2) contractual commitments (minimums, grace credits, smoothing) tied to deployment/security posture. We lack a quantitative model that connects telemetry -> pricing sensitivity -> contract language. This harness will let PM + Pricing + Legal run counterfactuals and produce recommended SQ language and pricing templates for sales.

Scope:
- Ingest anonymized session telemetry (token counts per direction, session durations, streaming handshake overhead, sequence length distribution) from hosted telemetry store for last 90 days.
- Implement simulation engine that can apply configurable pricing rules: input token rate, output token rate, streaming overhead multiplier, per-session floor minimums, grace-credit windows, and sliding smoothing.
- Run workload slices: chat-like (symmetrical I/O), LLM-as-backend (heavy output), ingestion pipelines (heavy input), and high-rate micro-sessions (short streaming with handshake cost).
- Generate revenue sensitivity matrix and per-customer risk bands (loss/gain vs baseline pricing).
- Create an SQ mapping doc: for each common questionnaire item (VPC, on-prem, audit logs, KMS), define operational constraints that materially affect pricing (eg. private deployments require reserved capacity -> different minimums).
- Produce a short PRD and a small set (2-3) of recommended contract language snippets and pricing templates for Sales to pilot.

Non-goals: full rollout of new pricing; legal approval of final contract language (this ticket hands off to Legal); changes to metering code in prod (this is simulation only).
acceptance_criteria: Sim harness can replay representative telemetry cohort and produce I/O ratio distributions for selected slices
Can apply at least five distinct pricing rule sets and output per-customer revenue delta vs baseline
SQ mapping doc with clear 1-to-1 examples for 6 common questionnaire items and suggested contract language fragments
Runbook describing data sources, privacy controls, and required infra for productionization
Presentation-ready deck and spreadsheet for Sales + Legal with three recommended pilot templates

notes: Privacy: all telemetry used for simulation must be aggregated or pseudonymized; do not export raw request payloads.
Risk: asymmetric pricing proposals can create arbitrage between hosted and dedicated customers if not gated by deployment flags.
Mitigation: map every pricing rule to a deployment and SQ constraint to avoid cross-product leakage.
